title: socialprofile
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): createdonbehalfby, customerid_account, customerid_contact, modifiedonbehalfby, ownerid, owningbusinessunit, owninguser, transactioncurrencyid.

blocked.description: Identifies if the social profile has been blocked.

community.description: Identifies where the social profile originated from, such as Twitter, or Facebook.

createdon.description: Date and time when the record was created.

exchangerate.description: Shows the conversion rate of the record's currency.

importsequencenumber.description: Unique identifier of the data import or data migration that created this record.

influencescore.description: Shows the score that determines the online social influence of the social profile.

modifiedon.description: Date and time when the record was modified.

overriddencreatedon.description: Date and time that the record was migrated.

profilefullname.description: Shows the display name of the customer on this social profile.

profilelink.description: Shows the customer that this social profile belongs to.

profilename.description: Shows the name of the social profile on the corresponding social channel.

socialprofileid.description: Unique Identifier of the social profile name.

statuscode.description: Reason for the status of the Social Profile

uniqueprofileid.description: Unique ID of the Profile ID

utcconversiontimezonecode.description: Time zone code that was in use when the record was created.

versionnumber.description: Version number of the social profile.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who created the record.

_customerid_value.description: Shows the customer that this social profile belongs to.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who modified the record.

_ownerid_value.description: Shows the user or team that is assigned to manage the record.

_owningbusinessunit_value.description: Unique identifier for the business unit that owns the record

_owninguser_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who owns the contact.

_transactioncurrencyid_value.description: Choose the local currency for the record to make sure budgets are reported in the correct currency.
